propositions: A child bug closed with disposition class (duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated) and a live replacement link bypasses completion verification in the close gate but is later rejected by child_closure_findings as uncertified because it lacks a completion-verifier attestation.

The close path exempts disposition closes from the completion-verifier requirement (transition_close.py:253-260) while the certification path does not honor that exemption (llm/completion.py:170-199), creating an unresolvable state with no non-force remedy.

An honestly-linked disposition-closed child cannot earn certification by reopening and reclosing—it takes the same exemption branch every time—and cannot be certified without either misclassifying its close class or hiding its replacement link.

The completion-verifier attestation now includes DISPOSITION class and replacement ticket ID in its manifest rather than falsely claiming a PASS that never occurred, preserving auditability of verified vs. disposed closures.

Certification must forward through a disposition close's replacement link (certified iff replacement's closure is certified-and-valid) instead of demanding an attestation the child is exempt from producing.
